Agree on roles, communication channel, and meeting time

## Goal

Make sure everyone knows who does what and how the team stays in touch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every member has a primary and a secondary role. Everyone still writes code.
- [ ] The team has picked a communication channel and agreed how fast to reply.
- [ ] A weekly meeting outside class is on everyone's calendar.
- [ ] The team has written down what happens when someone goes quiet for three days.

## Where to look

Canvas: KICKOFF! Project Planning and Team Collaboration, section 3, and Group Project Structure & Expectations.
